top_signals.title: White House vows to press ahead with tariffs despite midterm backlash over rising prices
top_signals.summary: Business executives warned at a Washington summit of rising costs and shifting supply chains as polls showed growing opposition to Trump's tariffs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Fossil CEO says turnaround is ahead of plan as sales return to growth
top_signals.summary: Watchmaker Fossil said Tuesday that the company is returning to profit and sales growth in the first signs of its turnaround strategy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Bitget Wallet reports sevenfold jump in crypto phishing risk alerts
top_signals.summary: The wallet flagged about 37,000 signing requests a week for phishing in Q3 and said better monitoring likely contributed to the increase.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: CSG Shares Plunge as Arms Firm Cuts Full-Year Margin Outlook
top_signals.summary: CSG NV shares plunged to the lowest since their January listing after the European arms maker cut its full-year profitability outlook, dealing a fresh blow to investors who bought into the stock on optimism over rapid growth in defense spending.

top_signals.title: Bitmine posts $6.3B net loss for fiscal 2026 as Ether prices slide
top_signals.summary: Bitmine booked $6.2 billion in unrealized losses on digital assets. It held 6.07 million ETH on Sunday, or 4.97% of Ether’s supply.
